claim: For A0=Q[x,y,z]/(x^3,y^3,z^3,xyz), every linear form fails maximal rank A2->A3, so the non-Lefschetz locus is P^2; at x+y+z the Jordan partition is [5,4,4,2,2,1,1].

correctness.evidence: Independent monomial-basis enumeration gave Hilbert dimensions 1,3,6,6,3; independently constructed M2(a,b,c) has symbolic determinant 0 and rank 5 at (1,1,1); exact 19x19 multiplication by x+y+z gave kernel dimensions 7,12,15,18,19 and Jordan partition [5,4,4,2,2,1,1].

originality.evidence: Brenner-Kaid, arXiv:math/0604406v2, Example 3.1, studies exactly (X^3,Y^3,Z^3,XYZ) and proves generic A2->A3 failure with a parameterized kernel. Migliore-Miro-Roig-Nagel, arXiv:0811.1023, records the same example and Corollary 7.4 also covers (alpha,beta,gamma,t)=(1,1,1,2). Since the degeneracy locus is determinantal closed, generic failure already forces the 6x6 determinant to vanish identically and hence the whole P^2 locus.

value.evidence: After prior-art coverage, the remainder is a direct certificate for an already-known one-off example plus a Jordan partition at one chosen linear form. No new family, classification, rank-stratification, structural mechanism, or reusable theorem is established.

literature.citation: H. Brenner and A. Kaid, Syzygy Bundles on P^2 and the Weak Lefschetz Property, arXiv:math/0604406v2, Example 3.1 (published Illinois J. Math. 51 (2007), 1299-1308).
literature.mapping: Exact ideal (X^3,Y^3,Z^3,XYZ); generic linear-form failure A2->A3 and parameterized kernel.

literature.citation: J. C. Migliore, R. M. Miro-Roig, U. Nagel, Monomial ideals, almost complete intersections and the Weak Lefschetz Property, arXiv:0811.1023; Trans. AMS 363 (2011), 229-257.
literature.mapping: Introduction identifies the exact Brenner-Kaid example; Corollary 7.4 includes (alpha,beta,gamma,t)=(1,1,1,2) as case (3), rho=0.

repair.assessment: A bounded wording repair can turn the record into a worked certificate for a classical example, but it cannot supply missing originality/value. A substantive retry requires a genuinely new family/classification/structural result.
